_comment: Public keys a release must be signed with (scripts\lib\Signature.ps1, docs\security.md#signed-releases). The updater and install.ps1 install a release only when its release.json is signed with one of them; config\machine.json cannot add one. Written by scripts\New-ReleaseKey.ps1, which writes the same keys into install.ps1; the private key lies encrypted on a USB stick of the maintainer.
